thread:
sam: spinning up a follow-up thread for the midnight KV OOM cascade (eu/asia clusters). We saw multiple shards hit hard limits after a delete spike. Want to lock owners/timelines for remediation items.

ravi: saw it too. short signal summary: tombstone backlog + slow slab coalescing. heap dump: snap-kv-2026-04-18-0029.tar.gz (bucket infra-dumps).

ana: quick read of the dump: ~90MB of metadata stranded per affected shard; fragmentation ratio per shard climbed from ~1.1 -> 2.8 during the spike.

lee: immediate low-risk mitigations we can push now:
- bump kv.shard_soft_limit += 12%
- turn on tombstone_fast_compact for hot partitions (>100 deletes/s)
I can own the rollout and watch canary. target: canary in 2 hours.

sam: assign lee for canary. ravi can you prep the runbook and healthchecks?

ravi: yep. healthcheck: fail if OOM events >0, 95th latency increases >30%, or CPU > 80% sustained for 5m. I'll add rollback steps and a toggle. PR by 1h.

ana: medium-term followups (owners + goals):
- continuous low-overhead allocation sampler (owner: ana) -> emit per-shard residency p50/p95, tombstone_age histogram. prototype by 2026-04-29.
- GC cadence tuning + A/B (owner: sam) -> plan + infra by 2026-04-24.
- bounded defragmenter job (owner: lee) -> PoC by 2026-05-02; must be opt-in and rate-limited.
- eviction & reclaim probe tests in CI (owner: ravi) -> harness by 2026-04-26.
- observability: add tombstone_age and eviction_miss_rate to console (owner: ana) -> dashboard & alerts by 2026-04-22.

ops-bot: Incident linked: INC-2026-0418-KV-RECLAIM; severity: S2. Reminders set for owners 72h before due dates.

lee: note on defrag PoC: algorithm will run a bounded compaction loop, stopping if CPU > configured headroom or p95 latency increases > 15%. Will include safety knobs.

ana: sampling overhead target: <1% CPU at steady state, spike-safe sampling windows. We'll only sample a shard for short windows and aggregate.

ravi: CI eviction probe sketch: spawn 10k deletes in loop, measure reclaim latency and tombstone_age before/after; baseline must show >40% reduction in tombstone_age post-merge. Owner: ravi.

sam: assigning timelines recap:
- canary rollout (lee + ravi): tonight, canary results within 2h
- runbook PR (ravi): 1h
- eviction probe harness (ravi): 2026-04-26
- observability metrics (ana): 2026-04-22
- GC A/B plan (sam): 2026-04-24
- sampler prototype (ana): 2026-04-29
- defrag PoC (lee): 2026-05-02

pm-bot: Linked PM doc: https://redwood-internal/pm/kv-reclaim-2026-04-18 (section: Followups).

lee: starting canary now on the canary pool; will post short status in ~30m.

ana: regression risk callout: tombstone_fast_compact can raise short-term CPU and IO. Include CPU headroom and an automated rollback trigger.

ravi: added automated rollback in runbook: if CPU > configured headroom for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 25% for 5m -> rollback.

sam: also adding a weekly detection query: if more than 2 shards per cluster see >1.5x residency growth in 48h, auto-create follow-up thread and ping owners. Owner: sam. cadence: weekly review + auto-trigger.

lee: canary update: first 10m looks stable, no OOMs, CPU within expected. posting logs to the PR.

ana: thanks. i'll start the sampler prototype in a dev cluster tomorrow and share traces.

ravi: will merge the runbook once green and schedule the eviction-probe job in CI.

sam: closing this thread for now. Reopen if blockers or canary fails. Keep only short status updates here. :white_check_mark:
